summary: This is an XML document that stores information about a collection of books in a bookstore. Each book entry contains metadata like title, author, publication year, price, and category. The document follows standard XML conventions with a declaration at the start and organizes all books within a root bookstore element.

explanations.1: The first part declares this is XML version 1.0 with UTF-8 character encoding. The rest defines a bookstore root element containing multiple book entries, where each book has attributes (like category) and child elements (like title, author, year, price) that describe that book.
